description: Checks on the accessible outputs of velocidade-instantanea.pdf that the formula ground truth (ground_truth.csv) does not cover: repaired text, document structure and formula speech. Patterns are Python regular expressions applied to the plain-text output (TXT, or text extracted from the PDF/UA) unless 'target' says otherwise. They target the artifacts of the Acessilia pipeline's extraction (Docling through the Toolbox's document.structure.extract), which keeps TeX spacing accents, split ligatures and a detached U+0338 for ≠; a different extractor shows other artifacts (pdftotext composes accents and ligatures but prints ≠ as '6='), so the checks are meant for the pipeline's outputs, not for an arbitrary text extraction of the PDF.

must_match.why: dotless i + acute in the TeX text layer
TeX grave accent (\`a) extracts as a spacing ‘ or ` before the letter
the fi ligature extracts as 'fi ca'
h ≠ 0 appears five times; losing the slash inverts the meaning
table cell; the sign carries the meaning

must_not_match.why: a combining long solidus that did not compose into ≠
≠ drawn as the glyphs '6' and '=' (the form pdftotext gives); the body has no legitimate '6='

page_header.text: Universidade de Brasília Departamento de Matemática

page_numbers.check: no body block on page N whose whole text is N (a structural check, because a lone digit line also comes from flattened fractions and table values)

images.note: the UnB logo next to the header text; a description should not repeat the header text

ordered_lists.first_item_starts: Com o auxílio de uma calculadora
ordered_lists.why: the text later refers to 'item 2 acima'

speech.description: Each listed display formula must have a spoken form (alt text / verbalization) that contains at least one of the words in any_of, case-insensitively. The words name the structure a listener must not lose; they do not pin an exact verbalizer output.
